```{r, echo=F, eval=FALSE}

# Sanity check
library(GeneralDualSimplex)


set.seed(1)
V <- matrix(rexp(60 * 45), 60, 45)

# Run the end-to-end dual simplex pipeline
dso <- CreateDSO(V) |>
  FilterDSO(rows = 1:50) |>
  ScaleDSO(type = "expression") |>
  FindProjection(k = 3) |>
  FindSolution(solver = "positivity") |>
  RunReduction(gsvd_dims = 2:3)

dso
```

# B: Different noise model changes simplex geometry in the projected space differently.
Representative projections
```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=10}
EXAMPLE_L <- "1/2"
EXAMPLE_SEED <- 17

show_names <- list(
  "none" = "Noiseless",
  "Normal" = "Normal",
  "Poisson" = "Poisson",
  "Mul" = "Multiplicative",
  "NB" = "Neg. Binom."
)
```




```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
# feature simplex
for (noise in unique(experiments$NOISE)) {
  fvertex <- experiments[
    NOISE == noise
    & NOISE_LEVEL %in% c("0", EXAMPLE_L)
    & SEED == EXAMPLE_SEED,
    result
  ][[1]] %>%
    slot("misc") %>%
    getElement("true_vertices") %>%
    getElement("X") %>%
    as.data.table(keep.rownames = T)
  
  
  fdata <- experiments[
    NOISE == noise
    & NOISE_LEVEL %in% c("0", EXAMPLE_L)
    & SEED == EXAMPLE_SEED,
    result
  ][[1]] %>%
    slot("reduction") %>%
    getElement("gsvd") %>%
    slot("features") %>%
    as.data.table(keep.rownames = T)
  
  p <- ggplot(mapping = aes(x = dim2, y = dim3)) +
    geom_polygon(
      data = fvertex,
      fill = "#E69F00",
      alpha = 0.25,
      color = "black",
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    ggrastr::geom_point_rast(
      data = fdata,
      color = "gray50",
      size = 0.5
    ) +
    labs(title = show_names[[noise]]) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_blank()
    )
  
  print(p)
}

```



```{r, fig.width=25, fig.height=20, eval=F, echo=F}
dualplot_with_triangle <- function(dso, solution = F, ...) {
  add_true_vertices(
    DualPlot(dso, history = F, solution = solution, ...),
    dso@misc$true_vertices,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.4
  )
}


noise_level_to_plot <- "1/2"

# feature
for (noise_model in unique(experiments$NOISE)) { print(
  unique(experiments$SEED) %>%

      experiments[

        & SEED == seed,

        `[[`(1) +
        labs(title = f("{noise_model}: seed {seed}"))
    }) %>%
    patchwork::wrap_plots(ncol = 5)
)}
```

# C: DualSimplex method has different deconvolution accuracy under different noise models.
```{r}
evaluations <- pmap(experiments, function(..., result) {
  c(
    list(...),
    as.data.table(result@misc$evaluation, keep.rownames = T)
  )}) %>%
  rbindlist()

evaluations[["SEED"]] %<>% factor()
evaluations[["NOISE"]] %<>% factor(levels = c("none", "Normal", "Poisson", "Mul", "NB"))

head(evaluations)
```


```{r}
noise_model_to_plot <- c("none", "Normal", "Poisson", "Mul", "NB")
```

```{r, fig.width=5.5, fig.height=6}
which.side <- "W"
ggplot(
  evaluations[NOISE %in% noise_model_to_plot & metric == "rmse" & side == which.side],
  mapping = aes(
    x = NOISE_LEVEL,
    y = value
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = F) +
  geom_point() +  #aes(color = SEED)) +
  facet_grid(
    cols = vars(NOISE),
    space = "free",
    scales = "free_x"
  ) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  labs(
    title = f("Deconvolusion error of {which.side}"),
    x = "Noise level",
    y = "RMSE (lower is better)"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)

ggplot(
```

# D: Sinkhorn scaling increases the variance share of low-expression features.
```{r}
fdata <- pmap(experiments, function(..., result) {
  c(
    list(...),
    as.data.table(result@metadata$row, keep.rownames = T)
  )}) %>%
  rbindlist()

fdata[["SEED"]] %<>% factor()
fdata[["type"]] %<>% factor(levels = c("marker", "background"))
fdata[["NOISE"]] %<>% factor(levels = c("none", "Normal", "Poisson", "Mul", "NB"))

fdata[, `:=`(
  mass_sum = sum(total),
  sacling_sum = sum(scaling),
  scaled_mass_sum = sum(scaled_total),
  var_sum = sum(var),
  scaled_var_sum = sum(scaled_var)

), by = c("SEED", "NOISE", "NOISE_LEVEL")]

fdata[, `:=`(
  var_share = 100 * var / var_sum,
  scaled_var_share = 100 * scaled_var / scaled_var_sum,
  
  signal_var_share = 100 * signal_var / var_sum,
  noise_var_share = 100 * noise_var / var_sum,
  cov_share = 100 * 2 * cov / var_sum,

  scaled_signal_var_share = 100 * scaled_signal_var / scaled_var_sum,
  scaled_noise_var_share = 100 * scaled_noise_var / scaled_var_sum,
  scaled_cov_share = 100 * 2 * scaled_cov / scaled_var_sum

)]

fdata[, `:=`(
  var_share_ratio = scaled_var_share / var_share,
  bin = factor(dplyr::ntile(rank, 5))
)]

n_seed <- length(unique(experiments$SEED))


# fdata[, bin := factor(dplyr::ntile(rank, 5))]
```


```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
plot_dt_long <- fdata[
  # NOISE_LEVEL %in%  c("0", "1"),
  NOISE_LEVEL %in%  c("0", "1/4"),
  .(NOISE, rank, bin, var_share, scaled_var_share)
] %>%
  melt(
    id.vars = c("NOISE", "rank", "bin"),
    variable.name = "scaling",
    value.name = "var_share"
  )

setattr(plot_dt_long[["scaling"]], "levels", c("Before", "After"))
```



```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=5.5}
ggplot(
  plot_dt_long,
  mapping = aes(
    x = rank,
    y = var_share,
    color = scaling,
    fill = scaling
  )
) +
  # Shaded ribbon for the full range (min to max)
  stat_summary(
    geom = "ribbon",
    fun.min = min,
    fun.max = max,
    alpha = 0.25,
    color = NA
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Before" = "#009E73", "After" = '#D55E00')) +
  # Solid line for the mean
  stat_summary(
    geom = "point",
    fun = mean,
    # linewidth = 0.8
    size = 0.1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Before" = "#009E73", "After" = '#D55E00')) +
  # facet_grid2(cols = vars(NOISE), scales = "free", independent = "y")+
  facet_grid(cols = vars(NOISE)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0))) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, plot_dt_long[NOISE == "none", quantile(var_share, probs = 0.999)]),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Raw expression rank (high -> low)",
    y = "Variance share (%)",
    color = "Scaling",
    fill = "Scaling"
    # ,
    # caption = f("{plot_dt_long[var_share >= plot_dt_long[NOISE == 'none', quantile(var_share, probs = 0.999)], .N]} total extreme feature omitted for visualization")
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```


```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=5.5}
before_pal <- colorRampPalette(c(

ggplot(

  mapping = aes(
    x = NOISE,
    y = var_share,
    fill = bin,
    group = bin
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    data = plot_data[scaling == "Before"],
    aes(
      x = NOISE,
      y = var_share,
      fill = bin
    )
```

# E: Variance share redistribution changes the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR).
```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
plot_dt_long <- fdata[
  NOISE_LEVEL == "1/4",
  .(NOISE, SEED, bin, signal_var_share, noise_var_share, scaled_signal_var_share, scaled_noise_var_share)
] %>%
  melt(
    id.vars = c("NOISE", "SEED", "bin"),
    measure.vars = measure(
      scaling = factor,
      type = factor,
      pattern = "^(scaled_)?(signal|noise)_var_share$"
    ),
    value.name = "var_share"
  )

setattr(plot_dt_long[["scaling"]], "levels", c("Before", "After"))
setattr(plot_dt_long[["type"]], "levels", c("Noise", "Signal"))

```



```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
ggplot(
  plot_dt_long[NOISE != "none", .(var_share = sum(var_share)), by = .(NOISE, scaling, bin, type, SEED)],
  mapping = aes(
    x = bin,
    y = var_share,
    fill = type
  )
) +
  # 2 side-by-side bars showing the mean across the 15 seeds
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "col",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Signal" = "#0072B2", "Noise" = '#CC79A7')) +
  # 15 dots per bar, centered on each bar and jittered slightly
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.15,
      jitter.height = 0,
      dodge.width = 0.8,
      seed = 1
    ),
    color = "black",
    size = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.6,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_nested(cols = vars(NOISE, scaling))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  labs(
    x = "Raw expression bin (high -> low)",
    y = "Variance share (%)",
    fill = "Source"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=6, eval=F, echo=F}
pdata <- pmap(experiments, function(..., result) {
  c(
    list(...),
    as.data.table(result@metadata$column, keep.rownames = T)
  )}) %>%
  rbindlist()

pdata[["SEED"]] %<>% factor()
pdata[["NOISE"]] %<>% factor(levels = c("none", "Normal", "Poisson", "Mul", "NB"))

pdata[, `:=`(
  var_sum = sum(var),
  scaled_var_sum = sum(scaled_var)

), by = c("SEED", "NOISE", "NOISE_LEVEL")]

pdata[, `:=`(
  signal_var_share = 100 * signal_var / var_sum,
  noise_var_share = 100 * noise_var / var_sum,
  scaled_signal_var_share = 100 * scaled_signal_var / scaled_var_sum,
  scaled_noise_var_share = 100 * scaled_noise_var / scaled_var_sum

)]


pdata[, bin := factor(dplyr::ntile(rank, 5))]


plot_dt_long <- pdata[
  NOISE_LEVEL == "1",
  .(NOISE, SEED, bin, signal_var_share, noise_var_share, scaled_signal_var_share, scaled_noise_var_share)
] %>%
  melt(
    id.vars = c("NOISE", "SEED", "bin"),
    measure.vars = measure(
      scaling = factor,
      type = factor,
      pattern = "^(scaled_)?(signal|noise)_var_share$"
    ),
    value.name = "var_share"
  )

setattr(plot_dt_long[["scaling"]], "levels", c("Before", "After"))
setattr(plot_dt_long[["type"]], "levels", c("Noise", "Signal"))



ggplot(
  plot_dt_long[NOISE != "none", .(var_share = sum(var_share) / n_seed), by = .(NOISE, scaling, type)],
  mapping = aes(
    x = NOISE,
    y = var_share,
    # color = scaling,
    fill = type,
    group = type
  )
) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = sum,
    geom = "col",
    position = "stack"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Signal" = "#0072B2", "Noise" = '#CC79A7')) +
  labs(
    y = "Variance share (%)",
    fill = "Source"
  ) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(scaling)) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_blank()
  )
```

# F: Decreased SNR ratio is linked to poor subspace estimation by singular value decomposition.
```{r}
base_noise_colors <- c(
  "Normal" = "#CC79A7", 
  "Poisson" = "#D55E00", 
  "Mul" = "#0072B2", 
  "NB" = "#009E73"
)


plot_dt <- experiments %>%
  pmap(function(..., result) {
    inertia <- result %>%
      GetData("biwhitened") %>%
      Matrix::norm(type = "F") %>%
      `^`(2) %>%
      `-`(1)
    
    spectral <- result@misc$spectral
    spectral_gap <- spectral[K] - spectral[K+1]

    c(
      list(...),
      data.table(
        component = names(spectral),
        spectral = spectral,
        normalized_spectral = spectral / inertia,
        spectral_gap = spectral_gap,
        normalized_spectral_gap = spectral_gap / inertia
      )
    )}) %>%
    rbindlist()

plot_dt[["component"]] %<>% 
  gsub("^dim", "", .) %>%
  factor(levels = as.character(1:30))
```



```{r, fig.width=5.5, fig.height=6}
expanded_color <- c("none" = "black", base_noise_colors)
  
ggplot(
  plot_dt[component %in% as.character(2:10) & NOISE_LEVEL %in% c("0", "1/4")],
  mapping = aes(
    x = component,
    y = normalized_spectral,
    color = NOISE,
    fill = NOISE,
    group = NOISE
  )
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = f("{K}"), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  stat_summary(
    geom = "ribbon",
    fun.min = min,
    fun.max = max,
    alpha = 0.25,
    color = NA
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = expanded_color) +
  stat_summary(
    geom = "point",
    fun = mean,
    # linewidth = 0.8
    size = 2
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    geom = "line",
    fun = mean,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = expanded_color) +
  labs(
    title = "Rank-3 signal (noise level = 0.25)",
    x = "k",
    # y = "Normalize singular value (σ)",
    y = bquote(~ "Normalize singular value" ~ σ[k]),
    color = "Noise",
    fill = "Noise"
  ) +
  theme(
    # axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    # axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r}
plot_data_wide <- c("W", "H") %>%
  lapply(function(which.side) {
    plot_data <- evaluations[
      NOISE != "none"
      & (side == which.side | is.na(side))
      & metric %in% c(
        "singular_value_ratio",
        "oracle_rmse", "rmse",
        "oracle_one_minus_r2", "one_minus_r2"
      ),
      .(NOISE, NOISE_LEVEL, SEED, side, metric, value)
    ]
    
    plot_data_wide <- dcast(
      plot_data,
      NOISE + NOISE_LEVEL + SEED + rowid(metric) ~ metric,
      value.var = "value"
    )[, metric := NULL]
    
    plot_data_wide[["side"]] <- which.side
    
    plot_data_wide
  }) %>%
  rbindlist()

plot_data_wide[["side"]] %<>% factor(levels = c("W", "H"))
```
